test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 34

questions.question: A tank can be filled by pipe A in 3 hours and by pipe B in 9 hours. At 9 a.m., pipe A was opened. By what time will the tank be filled if pipe B is also opened at 10 a.m.?

Virendra deposited a certain sum of money at 20% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. At the end of 2 years, he received a total amount of ₹99,036. What was the sum of money (in ₹) deposited by Virendra?
A person saves 90% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹400, then his income (in ₹) is:
A bus is moving at a speed of 73 km/h. If its speed is reduced by 20%, then the new speed of the bus (in km/h) will be:
If m varies directly with n, and m = 1235 when n = 1040, then find the value of m when n = 772.
Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 8.5 years at 12% per annum rate of interest.

Pipe A can fill a tank in 6 hours, pipe B can fill the same tank in 4 hours, and pipe C can fill the same tank in 12 hours. The time taken (in hours) by them to fill the same tank if they operate together is:

A man bought two types of pencils, one at a rate of 6 for ₹7 and the other at ₹6 each. He purchased an equal number of pencils from each type and then sold all of them at ₹6 per pencil. What was his profit percentage?
If 35% of a number exceeds 20% of it by 90, then the number is:
The value of x in the proportion equation 28 : 63 :: 36 : x is:
A 210 m long train crosses a man walking at a speed of 4.5 km/h in the opposite direction in 12 seconds. What is the speed (in km/h) of the train?
The average of three numbers is 20. If two numbers are 12 and 27, then the third number is:

A solid metallic sphere of radius 5 cm is melted and recast into 125 identical spheres. What is the ratio of the surface area of the original sphere to the total surface area of 7 smaller spheres so formed?
Akshay has borrowed an amount of ₹3,00,000 from a bank to start a business. How much simple interest (in ₹) will he pay at a rate of 6% per annum after 4 years?
A shopkeeper professes to sell his goods at a 30% loss but uses a false balance and gains 85%. The actual weight (correct to one decimal place) he uses for 1 kg is:
A man covers distances of 385 km, 297 km and 104 km at speeds of 35 km/hr, x km/hr and 52 km/hr, respectively. If his average speed for the whole journey is 48 km/hr, then what is the value of x?
If 30 workers earn ₹4,000 in 4 days, how much (in ₹) will 53 workers earn in 6 days?
The average weight of Mandar, Ketan and Tushar is 46 kg. If the average weight of Mandar and Ketan is 41 kg and that of Ketan and Tushar is 46 kg, then the weight of Ketan (in kg) is:
In a clearance sale of electronic items, an item whose marked price was ₹12,200 is now sold for ₹10,004; d% is discount percentage on the item. The value of d is:
If 2.5 : 19.5 :: 12 : x, find the value of x.
